span.p:
Gets its voucher number (JV-2026-00012):
gapless per voucher type, in posting order.
Immutable in the database: amounts, accounts,
dates, status and voucher number never change.
Correct by reversing.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Not in balances or reports. Has a voucher
type (JV, CPV, CRV, BPV, BRV…) but no number
yet, so voided drafts leave no gaps.
